description: Image Description: The image displays a single, vertical, white line centered against a black background. The line is thin and appears to be of uniform width throughout its length. It is straight and extends from the top to the bottom of the frame, occupying a central position in the composition. There are no other visible elements, textures, or colors present in the image, making the white line the sole focus. The contrast between the white line and the black background is stark, emphasizing the simplicity and minimalism
